title: AgentHarnessManagedSettings
description: Agent host settings that enforce the default harness's MCP access before any hook runs, returned by `GET /v1/agentHarness/managedSettings`. An administrator pastes them into the host's managed configuration.

serverName.description: Name the OpenMetadata MCP server must have in the agent host's configuration for these settings to keep it allowed.

serverUrl.description: URL of the OpenMetadata MCP server.

claudeCode.description: JSON for Claude Code managed settings: `deniedMcpServers` for blocked servers and, when the default denies unlisted servers, `allowedMcpServers` with `allowManagedMcpServersOnly`.

codexRequirementsToml.description: The `mcp_servers` allowlist for Codex `requirements.toml`. Empty when the default allows unlisted servers, because Codex has no denylist.

notes.description: What the settings cannot express, such as entries limited to some tools, which only the hooks enforce.
